raw_response:
This small plot of mine, just a little piece behind the house, I plant my cassava and cocoyam together like I always do. I cannot afford to buy fertilizer bag for such small land — one bag is too much and the money is not there. I will put the kitchen ash and small household refuse I gather through the year, and use the cassava stems I kept from last harvest. My children and I will work it ourselves; no money to hire anybody.
